name: astrapool
description: A 7-foot pool table you can walk around, in the browser: real physics, house-rules 8-ball, four computer styles, private online rooms, and a solar system you can rack

scripts.deploy: npm run heads:guard && npm run build && (npm run analytics:migrate || echo 'Warning: D1 migrations failed; deploying gameplay anyway. Analytics may be unavailable.') && wrangler deploy
scripts.dev:online: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply GAME_ANALYTICS --local && wrangler dev --port 8787
scripts.deploy:private: npm run heads:restore && npm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.private.jsonc
